carriage: HOST app.rpc, exact locally enabled environment grant; account broker or direct device

request.workspace: default or SHA256 of canonical registered worktree path
request.title: 0..256 printable UTF8 bytes
request.expected: empty for read, SHA256 Git state for writes
request.command: empty for read, 32 lower hex for writes

response.worktrees: one page of up to 8 registered worktrees; selection scans the complete bounded registry
response.branches: one page of up to 16 branches
response.pull_requests: one page of up to 3 GitHub PRs
response.diff_cut: true if large or non-UTF8 diff omitted/shortened
response.repository: validated GitHub origin owner/repository; explicitly supplied to PR writes

receipt: exact canonical request persisted before effects; exact response after completion; a claimed command lacking a response remains unknown and is never rerun
scope: registered worktrees of adopted repository only; no client paths; removal only service-created worktrees, never force; no arbitrary remote URLs; credentials remain on computer
